instruction: Candid studio photograph, close-up shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain white background and blurred purple flowers in the foreground, three women are huddled tightly in a joyful embrace. On the left, the woman with wavy light-brown hair (R3) in a white shirt smiles and looks down. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a white top and denim jacket laughs joyfully with her mouth open. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R1) in a white shirt smiles warmly. They are locked in a tight group hug, with the outer two women wrapping their arms around the laughing center woman. The lighting is bright and soft, highlighting their happy expressions.
